evidence: The surface morphology of the SnOx ALD films was evaluated using atomic force microscopy (AFM) on polished p-type Si (1 0 0) wafers. The SnOx ALD growth rates have been reported to be 0.25–0.80 Å per AB cycle at 250–400 ◦C, respectively. The film density of 5.64 g/cm 3 was determined by X-ray reﬂectivity (XRR) measurements for SnO x ALD films grown on silicon wafers. The mass changes corresponding with SnO x ALD were converted to film thicknesses using the density of the SnOx ALD film. The resistance of the SnO x film was measured during the ALD process using the Keithley 195A digital multimeter. The sensor response was defined as the ratio of the resistance in O 2, RO2 , to the resistance in O 2 and CO, RO2+CO: S = RO2 / RO2+CO. The resistance was also measured versus time in transient experiments to determine the gas sensor response time. The sensor response measurements for SnO x ALD films with increasing thicknesses from 15.9 Å to 26.2 Å are shown in Fig. 8. The sensor response measurements for SnO x ALD films with increasing thicknesses from 26.2 Å to 58.7 Å are shown in Fig. 9. The sensor response was measured using an O 2 pressure of 46 mTorr and a CO pressure of 20 mTorr.
